market_note: Re-checked 24 Aug 2026 against LINK via Tea Lane, Viewpoints, Anchor, Island RE, Elliman, Verani, Austin MV, Coldwell/Sandpiper, and Zillow. All 21 listings already in the 21 Aug file are still live at the same price and status: 10 Danls Way remains contingent at $1.70M; 11 Oak Lane remains pending at $2.25M; 39 Ferro Way is still the only clearly in-budget 5BR/4BA in Tisbury at $1.488M. No tracked homes went pending, sold, or took a cut since 21 Aug. What changed is inventory we had not yet logged: 188 Vineyard Meadow Farms (WT south shore, 3BR main + year-round 1BR guesthouse with kitchen on 1.4 acres, $1.80M, seller credits a 4BR septic upgrade) is another Farms End analog in the same neighborhood as 63 VMF; 150 Field View Lane (WT, 4BR Cape + detached 384-sf studio with its own septic on 2 acres across from Nip 'n Tuck / North Tisbury, $1.60M estate) is the closest geography to 19 Farms End still active; 20 Brook Hollow (Lambert's Cove, 4BR/3BA on 2.04 expandable acres, Active $1.325M after a long cut from a $1.90M original ask, sold AS-IS/dated, laundry could convert to a 5th bedroom); and 14 Ephriam Allen (Cedar Tree Neck, 3BR main + 1BR studio on 5.45 acres, $2.375M on Tea Lane — stretch budget and ~25 min from Nancy's). Left off after review: 24 Towanticut Ave land ($789k, approved 8BR septic + ADU building permit but only 0.39 acre — too tight for a pool compound); 41 & 0 Cook Rd ($1.79M, 3BR + adjacent 16,000-sf buildable lot); 187 Lagoon Pond Rd ($2.695M, 5BR/2BA historic Ben Luce Homestead — baths short of 3+); 33 Alyssa Ln ($1.395M, 4BR, 0.23 acre, 4BR septic that must be upgraded to nitrogen-reducing); 5 Pine Tree Ln ($1.999M, 4BR, 0.18 acre West Chop); 9 Chickawaukee ($1.895M, 4/2, 4BR septic, 0.38 acre, rented summer 2026); 4 High Meadow ($2.26M, 4/3.5, 0.89 acre, garage ADU not built); 40 Scotchmans Ln ($1.495M, 4BR/2BA on 3.76 acres, cesspool); 14 High Meadow (3BR septic); 24 Harrison Ave (2BR, listed ~21 Aug); 3 Hidden Cove (4BR/3.5, 0.29 acre, pending $2.295M); 10 Trotters Ln (3BR, pending). 42 Field View Ln ($799k artists camp, no confirmed 5–6BR septic) and 30/35 Double Ox (3BR-only Amphidrome) remain out. A true 5BR/3+BA under $2M within 25 minutes of Nancy's is still scarce. Two-dwelling WT compounds (188 VMF, 63 VMF, 150 Field View) and land+build remain the cleaner path to a 5–6BR pool compound. Chilmark/Aquinnah skipped as too far; no invented addresses.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; ~0.7 mi to Owen Park, ~0.6 mi to Lake Tashmoo landing
listings.notes: Best in-budget 5BR/4BA we found. 2020 build with a permitted walkout ADU, first-floor primary, and a 6-bedroom septic already in place so a detached guest house is a real path. Lot is only 0.36 acres so a pool is tight but the ADU already splits two family units. Tashmoo Watershed / NitROE system is a due-diligence item.

listings.beach_access: association / private beach access noted on listing
listings.notes: Rare under-$2M compound: 4BR 1850 farmhouse plus detached 1BR guest cottage on 1.27 acres of lawn near Alley's. Sleeps as 5BR/3BA with separate guest unit for another family. Tea Lane still flags a contingent offer as of 21 Aug 2026 — backup only unless it falls through. Room to garden and entertain; not a pool listing.

listings.beach_access: association beach; 0.3 mi to Sengekontacket Pond, community dock/kayak racks, access toward State Beach
listings.notes: Turn-key 4BR main house plus detached studio/loft with full bath (MLS counts 5BR) on 1.5 acres in Hidden Cove. Association tennis, pickleball, dock and pond access are a strong summer-use match. Over budget at $2.4M; Compass had shown under-contract earlier but Viewpoints still lists Active on 18 Aug 2026 — confirm status with the listing agent.

listings.beach_access: steps to Eastville Beach / public beach; two parcels from shoreline
listings.notes: Closest 6BR/4BA to Nancy's: renovated 1859 Greek Revival with two first-floor ensuites, four upstairs bedrooms, rooftop deck, and Land Bank parcels on two sides. Sleeps a multi-unit family plus guests. Over budget; marketed with rental history (purchase-only search still fits). Compass $2.118M figure looks stale vs Elliman/Island RE/Anchor at $2.60M (price drop 15 Jul 2026).

listings.beach_access: across the street from Owen Park Beach / town dock
listings.notes: Updated 1808 Cape directly across from Owen Park: 5BR/4BA, two ensuites, harbor views, walk-to-town. Lot is only 0.20 acres so no pool/compound expansion. Reduced 14 Aug 2026 from $2.95M to $2.695M. Strong location, weaker as a 4-family compound.
listings.source: Wallace & Co. Sotheby's via Tea Lane

listings.beach_access: leisurely stroll to Owen Park town beach; public beach noted
listings.notes: Restored 1842 Greek Revival in the William Street Historic District, 1 block from Main Street and 2 from the ferry. 5BR/4BA with two first-floor bedrooms. Tiny 0.16-acre lot — no extension/pool. Over budget; better as a walkable in-town house than a family compound.

listings.beach_access: none noted; Lagoon Heights neighborhood, short drive to Lagoon/harbor beaches
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR main house plus a full 1BR guest apartment over the garage (separate kitchen/laundry) already functions as 5 sleeping rooms, on 1.38 acres in R3 with listing language that the lot is large enough for an in-ground pool (seller may escrow $50k toward a pool). 2026 gut renovation. Over budget but one of the better compound-shaped houses in Oak Bluffs.

listings.beach_access: Lambert's Cove Beach (town/resident) nearby; listing notes ocean/public beach ownership
listings.notes: Why expandable: 2BR main house + 2BR guest studio already split two dwellings, gunite pool on 2.9 acres, and the listing states future expansion to 12 bedrooms is possible with a septic upgrade. Slightly over $2M. Strongest pool+compound existing-home match in range. Still Active at $2.20M as of 21 Aug 2026 (Wallace / Verani MLS 73564420; Tea Lane LINK #44818).

listings.beach_access: Hidden Cove association: direct Sengekontacket Pond access, tennis; public beach noted
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR/3BA plus a 512-sf finished lower level not counted in sqft (media/gym/office — possible 5th sleeping room if septic allows). Under $2M with pond/tennis amenities, but the 0.29-acre lot is too small for a real extension or pool. Honest fit: location/amenities yes, multi-family compound no.

listings.beach_access: short walk to Owen Little Beach / Yacht Club; public beach noted
listings.notes: In-budget 5BR/3BA that was already on LINK but missing from the 18 Aug file. 2002 three-level house with a garden-level 1BR guest apartment (kitchenette + full bath), plus 1BR on the main floor and 3BR upstairs. Lot is only 0.34 acres so no pool/compound expansion — same constraint as Ferro Way. Reduced from $1.65M (Sep 2025) to $1.595M (Dec 2025); still Active 21 Aug 2026. Honest fit: bedrooms and price yes, Farms End feel no.
listings.source: Wallace & Co. Sotheby's via Tea Lane (LINK #43800)

listings.beach_access: minutes to Long Point Beach / Long Point Wildlife Refuge; public beach noted
listings.notes: Closest living Farms End analog still for sale: wooded/pastoral West Tisbury, two dwellings (3BR main + separate 2BR guest house) on 1.6 acres, garage, listing language that the yard has room for a pool. Under $2M after a 14 Jul 2026 cut from $2.00M to $1.899M. Smaller houses than Farms End (2,075 sf combined) and south-shore rather than Island Farms / North Tisbury. Still Active 21 Aug 2026.
listings.source: The Agency via Viewpoints / Tea Lane (LINK #44385)

listings.beach_access: minutes to Long Point Beach / south shore; public beach noted
listings.notes: Why expandable / Farms End analog: same Vineyard Meadow Farms neighborhood as 63 VMF. 3BR main house (plus loft and ground-floor office) and a year-round 1BR guesthouse with full eat-in kitchen, living room, bath, and bonus attic — MLS counts 4BR/3BA combined on 1.4 fenced acres with garden and outdoor shower. Under $2M. Seller credits a 4-bedroom septic upgrade at closing (VLSE design in docs). South-shore rather than Island Farms / North Tisbury. Still Active 24 Aug 2026.
listings.source: Wallace & Co. Sotheby's via Tea Lane / Viewpoints (LINK #43626)

listings.beach_access: West Tisbury resident permit for Lambert's Cove Beach; public beach noted
listings.notes: Closest geography to 19 Farms End still for sale: Field View Lane is across from Nip 'n Tuck Farm in North Tisbury / Island Farms country. 1970 Cape (floor plan is 3BR + office; MLS counts 4) plus a detached 384-sf studio set back with its own parking, yard, and septic — two structures on 2 wooded/pastoral acres. Under $2M estate sale (*Estate Rules Apply). Studio is marketed as guest/artist/office space, not a full second dwelling like 63 VMF. Still Active 24 Aug 2026.

listings.beach_access: short bike ride / ~20 min walk to Lambert's Cove Beach; public beach noted
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR/3BA on 2.04 private acres in Long View / Lambert's Cove; MLS lot language is 'moderate and expandable,' and the listing says a huge first-floor laundry could convert to a 5th bedroom. Garage on site. Not two dwellings. Sold AS-IS and dated (1993, original ask $1.90M). Viewpoints/Tea Lane both show Active at $1.325M on 24 Aug 2026 — well under budget if the family will renovate. Honest fit: acreage and price yes, Farms End two-house feel no.
listings.source: Feiner Real Estate via Tea Lane / Viewpoints (LINK #43968)

listings.beach_access: abuts Cedar Tree Neck Sanctuary (trails, bluffs, beaches, bogs); public beach noted; winter water views
listings.notes: Farms End-shaped stretch: 3BR main house + detached 1BR studio with bath on 5.45 acres of lawn, trees, and a small kettle pond, abutting 400 acres of Cedar Tree Neck Sanctuary. MLS 4BR/4BA. Over $2M. Drive from Nancy's is at the 25-minute edge (Indian Hill / north-shore WT). Tea Lane (listing broker) shows $2.375M on 24 Aug 2026; some IDX sites still echo $2.475M. Room for a pool on the open lawn; confirm septic bedroom count. Still Active 24 Aug 2026.

listings.beach_access: 0.2 mi to Grove Ave town beach; 0.5 mi to Owen Little Way town beach
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR/4BA expanded Cape listed 13 Aug 2026 with a private in-law wing (own entrance, kitchen, living room, BR, bath) plus a detached studio and finished basement. Under $2M on the way to West Chop. Sold as-is; AC only in the primary addition. 0.57 acres is tight for a pool but already functions as two living units. New since the 18 Aug pass.

listings.beach_access: minutes to Lambert's Cove Beach; public beach noted
listings.notes: Farms End-shaped: 3BR/3BA main house + 1BR garage ADU + two-story storage/workshop on 2.7 acres of lawn (same Oak Lane as the 99 Oak Lane pool compound). Stretch budget at $2.25M. Tea Lane flipped this from Active to Pending between 18 Aug and 21 Aug 2026 — watch only unless it falls through. No pool; basketball court and separate driveway for the ADU.
listings.source: Grace Hagerty Real Estate via Tea Lane (LINK #44446)

listings.beach_access: none noted; Oak Bluffs interior, short drive to State Beach / Sengekontacket
listings.notes: Most affordable 6-bedroom-septic lot we verified in Oak Bluffs. Approved 6BR septic plans, topo/survey/soils in hand; listing says main house + guest house possible with combined 6-bedroom cap. Best land path for a family compound near Nancy's if the family will wait out permitting/build. Coldwell Banker still Active at $975k (last MLS refresh 21 Aug 2026).

listings.beach_access: minutes to Oak Bluffs beaches; conservation trails from The Preserve
listings.notes: Last homesite in The Preserve at The Woodlands. 1.87 acres, underground utilities, town water, BOH approval for 6 bedrooms. HOA ~$2,500. Premium Oak Bluffs land for a custom 5–6BR compound; land alone is already near the $2M cap before vertical construction.

listings.beach_access: none noted; minutes to West Tisbury village / south-shore beaches by car
listings.notes: 3.42-acre pastoral parcel off Rogers Path marketed specifically as a custom Vineyard compound (main house, guest house, accessory structures with permitting). Building envelope already set. Lowest-priced larger lot in range; septic bedroom count not stated — confirm BOH before assuming 5–6BR.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; Vineyard Sound views; Lambert's Cove area
listings.notes: Ridge-top 3.01 acres with 1.41-acre building envelope, 6BR septic design approved, 12 gpm well in, NHESP cleared, CGI of a house + infinity pool. Strong custom-compound canvas. Drive time from Nancy's is near the 25-minute edge (Lambert's Cove / Fire Tower). Appointment-only; access crosses abutting land.

listings.beach_access: minutes to Lambert's Cove Beach; public beach noted on MLS
listings.notes: 3.32-acre hilltop with Site Plan Review and 6BR septic approvals in hand, well and power on site, and Sullivan & Associates plans for a 4BR/4.5BA house + garage (septic would allow more bedrooms). Reduced from $1.645M to $1.575M. Compound possible; ~22 min estimate from Oak Bluffs harbor.

listings.beach_access: none noted; <1 mile to Edgartown center / short drive to South Beach
listings.notes: Last lot in a 5-lot Edgartown subdivision. Town water AND town sewer, 7-bedroom capacity, building envelope set, marketed for a family compound with 3-car garage, pool and pool house. Neighbors already have substantial new construction. One of the cleanest build-a-compound paths in range.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; minutes to Long Point Beach / south shore preserve
listings.notes: 19.3 acres with approvals for a six-lot subdivision (one affordable). Each residential lot allows up to 6 bedrooms and an ADU. Surrounded ~75% by conservation. Over the $2M land budget but the only true multi-dwelling family-compound acreage we verified in the 25-minute radius. Could also remain one estate/farm.

listings.beach_access: adjacent Land Bank trails; short distance to Manaquayak / Ice House Pond swim; Lambert's Cove area
listings.notes: Newest land in range: listed 18 Aug 2026. 5.15 acres of old farmland with mature trees and stone walls, marketed specifically for a primary house plus an accessory structure. Soil testing done; buyer installs well, septic, and utilities. Bedroom count not approved yet — confirm BOH before assuming 5–6BR. Drive time from Nancy's is near the 25-minute edge (Davis Look / Lambert's Cove). Owner lives on the adjoining parcel; appointment only.
listings.source: Flanders Real Estate via Tea Lane / Anchor (LINK #44552)
